create_SpaceSequence: create a SpaceSequence with a name, subspace definition, and optional size range tuple
sample_SpaceSequence: sample a random variable-length list of elements from a SpaceSequence using its sample method
contains_SpaceSequence: check if a collection is contained in a SpaceSequence by validating length and element membership
eq_SpaceSequence: compare two SpaceSequence instances for equality by checking name, size range, and subspace
init_SpaceSequence: initialize a SpaceSequence with a gym Space subspace and default size range of zero to unbounded
